speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth whether the Ministry will consider expanding the usability of ActiveSG credits to include sports facilities beyond those currently under ActiveSG, such as those in community centres and The Kallang, to offer residents greater flexibility and encourage wider participation.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: I ask this Parliamentary Question because I have been approached by many residents who have asked to use the ActiveSG credits in community facilities, like in the Community Clubs for sports.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: And I want to ask the Ministry whether it will consider opening it up and ensuring that there is no fragmentation and there are no barriers to continue to help Singaporeans to remain active and healthy.

speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
text: We are aligned in wanting to provide more access to these facilities for our Singaporeans.
